    Bug 1928926 - Enforce different MRUTimes for folders tested for recentness. r=mkmelin
    
    While investigating an issue related to recentness, it was observed that
    the two folders used to test recentness in the WebExtension folders API
    had the same MRUTime value. This patch simply enforces different values,
    the folder created later being more recent.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D227818

diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/test_ext_folders_query_capabilities.js b/mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/test_ext_folders_query_capabilities.js
index 7459bf278b3..8838d13624b 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/test_ext_folders_query_capabilities.js
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/test_ext_folders_query_capabilities.js
@@ -687,6 +687,18 @@ add_task(async function test_FolderInfo_FolderCapabilities_and_query() {
   );
   await createMessages(OtherTestFolder, 1);
 
+  // Enforce different MRUTime values for folders used for recent tests. The
+  // "OtherTest" folder was created after the "InfoTest" folder and should be more
+  // recent.
+  InfoTestFolder.setStringProperty(
+    "MRUTime",
+    Math.floor(startTime.getTime() / 1000) + 1
+  );
+  OtherTestFolder.setStringProperty(
+    "MRUTime",
+    Math.floor(startTime.getTime() / 1000) + 2
+  );
+
   extension.onMessage("markSomeAsUnread", count => {
     const messages = InfoTestFolder.messages;
     while (messages.hasMoreElements() && count > 0) {
